findings.detail: Close copy of sample question 9. Sample 9 has a subagent that returns control to the coordinator for frequent lookups, a percentage split between simple and complex cases (85/15 there, 80/20 here), and a correct action of a scoped cross-role tool for the simple case with complex cases still routed through the coordinator. The distractors also mirror it: batching the needs, giving the full toolset, and pre-loading or caching context. Only the surface story changes (synthesis/verify_fact becomes generation/lookup_signature). The correct action is the same: sample option A, split here into options B and E.

blind_answer.reason: Following 2.3-S3, the frequent case (80% single-symbol signature checks) is handled by giving the generation subagent a narrow, scoped lookup_signature tool, which removes most round trips. Complex multi-module call-path tracing (20%) still goes through the coordinator to the exploration subagent, so each subagent stays within its role and remains reliable. Giving the generation subagent the full exploration toolset invites cross-specialization misuse, pre-loading every signature bloats its context, and batching lookups at the end of its pass doesn't work because it needs the answers during generation.
